newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Pac bond convertilbe to 255mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: First Pac bond convertilbe to 255mln shrs.

text.p: First Pacific Co Ltd said it would issue 254.6 million new shares, or 10.8 percent of its existing share capital, on full conversion of its US$350 million bond issue and the US$52.2 million planned in over-allotments.
The company said in a statement on Friday that the US$350 million in bonds would be convertible into First Pacific shares at HK$12.25 each between May 26, 1997 and March 13, 2002.
It said it would issue up to a further US$52.5 million in bonds to cover over-allotment.
The total net proceeds, including the additional bonds, of about US$391.5 million would be used to repay existing bank borrowings and for working capital, it said.
The bonds would bear interest of 2.0 percent per annum payable semi-annually.
The issue is expected to complete on March 27 and the bonds will be listed in London.
First Pacific shares ended at HK$10.55 on Thursday.
